fusions.name: Knuckle Lesson
fusions.desc: A two-fisted blow that deals 14 damage, leaves the target 12% easier to wound for 5 seconds, and stuns it for 1.2 seconds.

fusions.name: Hurled Rubble
fusions.desc: Throws a chunk of rock that deals 4 damage, rising to 1.6 times that at its full reach of 6 tiles.

fusions.name: Brachiate
fusions.desc: Swings you 4 tiles forward. Your movement speed rises 20% for 3 seconds afterward.

fusions.name: Returned in Kind
fusions.desc: Every time you take damage, a stack builds on you, up to 8. When you reach 8, they all spend at once: a blow strikes the nearest enemy within 8 tiles for 20% of your weapon damage per stack (163% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.
